title: DocXEval: A Systematic Evaluation of Explainability in Multimodal Document Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.36929v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal transformer models have driven unprecedented performance breakthroughs in modern document understanding. However, the inherent black-box nature of these models remains a major obstacle to their safe deployment in high-stakes sectors. Despite significant progress in explainability for vision and language tasks, explainable AI (XAI) research tailored to multimodal document understanding has received little attention. To address this gap, we present \ourframework{}, the first comprehensive explainability framework that adapts existing XAI methods and evaluation metrics to the multimodal (text, layout, and image) document understanding context, while introducing efficient multi-target adaptations of both methods and metrics for domain-specific tasks such as semantic entity recognition. Using \ourframework{}, we systematically evaluate 13 XAI methods across 3 document understanding tasks, 8 datasets, 4 models, and 17 evaluation met

translated_title: DocXEval：多模态文档理解中可解释性的系统性评估
translated_abstract: 多模态Transformer模型在现代文档理解领域推动了前所未有的性能突破。然而，这些模型固有的黑盒特性仍然是其在高风险领域安全部署的主要障碍。尽管针对视觉和语言任务的可解释性研究已取得显著进展，但面向多模态文档理解的可解释AI（XAI）研究却鲜受关注。为填补这一空白，我们提出了DocXEval，这是首个全面的可解释性框架，它将现有的XAI方法和评估指标适配到多模态（文本、布局和图像）文档理解场景中，同时针对语义实体识别等特定领域任务引入了高效的多目标方法和指标适配。借助DocXEval，我们系统地评估了13种XAI方法，涵盖3个文档理解任务、8个数据集、4个模型以及17个评估指标。
tldr: 本文提出了首个面向多模态文档理解的综合性可解释性评估框架DocXEval，将现有XAI方法与指标适配到文本、布局和图像的多模态场景，并对13种方法进行了跨任务、数据集、模型和指标的系统性评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DocXEval, the first comprehensive explainability framework for multimodal document understanding, which adapts existing XAI methods and metrics to the multimodal (text, layout, image) context and systematically evaluates 13 XAI methods across 3 tasks, 8 datasets, 4 models, and 17 metrics.
